title: I built an offline AI that knows your last frost date, no internet, no API
why_read: A fun small offline-AI hobby project combining a tabular forecasting model and a local LLM to predict garden frost dates, interesting as a practical example of running small AI stacks locally.
analysis: FrostWise is a hobby project combining an open-weight tabular machine learning model for frost-date prediction with a locally-run Gemma language model to generate planting advice, all running offline with no API calls. It's a nice small-scale demonstration of composing a traditional ML model with a local LLM for a practical, narrow use case, built for a specific person with poor internet access. The technical depth is modest, but it's a relatable, concrete example of privacy-respecting, fully local AI tooling.
